entries.femaleVariant: Cipher housing is still cold. Index is live.
entries.maleVariant: Cipher housing is still cold. Index is live.

entries.femaleVariant: Pull the physical key. Do not slot it into anything until we control the core.
entries.maleVariant: Pull the physical key. Do not slot it into anything until we control the core.

entries.femaleVariant: Core has two execution paths. Verify and forward, or revoke and wipe.
entries.maleVariant: Core has two execution paths. Verify and forward, or revoke and wipe.

entries.femaleVariant: Preserve or burn. Morita built the moral argument into the interface so operators could call themselves technicians.
entries.maleVariant: Preserve or burn. Morita built the moral argument into the interface so operators could call themselves technicians.

entries.femaleVariant: Twenty-six subject aliases. Seven completed pairs. Four marked unrecoverable.
entries.maleVariant: Twenty-six subject aliases. Seven completed pairs. Four marked unrecoverable.

entries.femaleVariant: And one live dispatch signature. Morita touched this ledger less than an hour ago.
entries.maleVariant: And one live dispatch signature. Morita touched this ledger less than an hour ago.

entries.femaleVariant: The ledger carries Morita's live attestation. Preserve the route and I can follow the next handshake upstream.
entries.maleVariant: The ledger carries Morita's live attestation. Preserve the route and I can follow the next handshake upstream.

entries.femaleVariant: The same route carries names for every stolen identity. Leave it open and anyone with the cipher can reconstruct them again.
entries.maleVariant: The same route carries names for every stolen identity. Leave it open and anyone with the cipher can reconstruct them again.

entries.femaleVariant: Burn it and Morita disappears behind the organization that paid him. We save today's couriers and guarantee replacements tomorrow.
entries.maleVariant: Burn it and Morita disappears behind the organization that paid him. We save today's couriers and guarantee replacements tomorrow.

entries.femaleVariant: Preserve it and the people already inside remain inventory. A future rescue does not cancel a present weapon.
entries.maleVariant: Preserve it and the people already inside remain inventory. A future rescue does not cancel a present weapon.

entries.femaleVariant: V, keep the line open. We trace Morita, copy what we need, then close it from the top.
entries.maleVariant: V, keep the line open. We trace Morita, copy what we need, then close it from the top.

entries.femaleVariant: There is no harmless copy. Erase the index and issue the wipe. Mara keeps her life. The route loses everyone else's.
entries.maleVariant: There is no harmless copy. Erase the index and issue the wipe. Mara keeps her life. The route loses everyone else's.

entries.femaleVariant: Preserve the index. We use it to find Morita.
entries.maleVariant: Preserve the index. We use it to find Morita.

entries.femaleVariant: Confirmed. Authenticate the cipher and leave the uplink intact.
entries.maleVariant: Confirmed. Authenticate the cipher and leave the uplink intact.

entries.femaleVariant: Burn the index. Nobody carries these people again.
entries.maleVariant: Burn the index. Nobody carries these people again.

entries.femaleVariant: Confirmed. Revoke every package, then destroy the local key.
entries.maleVariant: Confirmed. Revoke every package, then destroy the local key.

entries.femaleVariant: Route attested. Pair Zero-Seven verified. Next handoff pending.
entries.maleVariant: Route attested. Pair Zero-Seven verified. Next handoff pending.

entries.femaleVariant: Black Lantern accepted the cipher. I have Morita's next handshake.
entries.maleVariant: Black Lantern accepted the cipher. I have Morita's next handshake.

entries.femaleVariant: Mara's fragments are scrubbed. The wider index is still live. That part is yours now.
entries.maleVariant: Mara's fragments are scrubbed. The wider index is still live. That part is yours now.

entries.femaleVariant: Route revoked. Subject index purged. Package wipe issued.
entries.maleVariant: Route revoked. Subject index purged. Package wipe issued.

entries.femaleVariant: Index is gone. Wipe acknowledgements are returning now.
entries.maleVariant: Index is gone. Wipe acknowledgements are returning now.

entries.femaleVariant: Morita's signature just vanished. Save the signed destruction receipt. It is the only physical proof Black Lantern existed.
entries.maleVariant: Morita's signature just vanished. Save the signed destruction receipt. It is the only physical proof Black Lantern existed.
